name: Bee Hotel Price Alterator
description: Defines the PriceAlterator plugin type + manager and the base pricing machinery (weekly base-price table, season resolver) for Bee Hotel dynamic prices.
project_description: Bee Hotel Price Alterator is the base of Bee Hotel's dynamic pricing. It defines the PriceAlterator annotation plugin type and its plugin manager, the Alter/PreAlter services that run the alterator chain per night, a weekly per-unit base-price table (UnitBasePriceTable form/controller at /node/{node}/basepricetable), and base plugins GetSeason and PriceFromBaseTable. Concrete alterators (occupants, seasons, sliders, etc.) live in the sibling beehotel_pricealterators module and are discovered through this manager.
